news.title: Gryphon Investors forms ServiceNow services provider through Highmetric deal, later unified as NewRocket

summary: NewRocket. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 0% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: NewRocket is a global ServiceNow consulting partner, with a senior business analyst role in its Netherlands team in Amsterdam.

culture.text: A global team of ServiceNow professionals who help customers run and grow their ServiceNow setups.
Describes the Netherlands team as fast-paced, solving new problems every week.
Says it is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and is an equal opportunity employer.

open.text: Not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.

worth_knowing.text: Was formed by investor Gryphon Investors through the Highmetric deal and later unified under the NewRocket name.
